subject.title: Tailscale serve mode lacks optional secondary authentication

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in Gateway auth mode that requires token/password verification in addition to verified Tailscale Serve identity, and how should it interact with trusted-proxy and Control UI pairing?
rationale: This changes the Gateway authentication boundary and adds public config surface, so automation cannot choose the permanent policy without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Design layered auth contract
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in policy for identity plus shared-secret auth with schema/docs/tests and explicit warning or audit coverage.

options.title: Keep current supported paths
options.body: Continue documenting `allowTailscale: false` plus token/password as the hardening path, accepting that Tailscale identity and shared-secret auth are not composed.

options.title: Docs and warnings only
options.body: Improve warnings and docs around tokenless Serve identity without adding a new auth mode yet.

recommendation.title: Design layered auth contract
recommendation.body: Add a narrow opt-in policy for identity plus shared-secret auth with schema/docs/tests and explicit warning or audit coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history on Gateway auth hardening, Tailscale docs, and the adjacent no-auth exposure fix.
